title: Get the public notes ready to publish
statement: As a product manager, I can get a release's public notes as Markdown, so I can put them wherever our users read them without copying from private notes by mistake.
overview: Proposed addition, not in Trevor's direction. It lets the public notes go wherever the team's users read them, while a step in the team's checklist puts them there.

acceptance_criteria.statement: `release notes --audience public` prints the release's public notes, and no text from any internal note.
The command only prints: it changes no file outside its output and publishes nothing.
